subject: Evidence retention timeline and regional exit plan
messages:
From: Dominic Webb <d.webb@acmehealth.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
Cc: secops@acmehealth.com
Date: Sat, 14 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request to preserve logs and transfer scope for EU incident

Hi Jasmine,

We're opening a short forensic window after a security event yesterday that affected a subset of Acme Health EU customers. Our legal & compliance team requires preservation of session logs, auth traces, and any related KV cache snapshots for a 90-day investigation window. We need to confirm:

- Which regional slices of logs you can preserve (EU only vs global)
- Retention start and earliest allowed deletion date
- Whether Redwood can produce a redacted export (PII removed) or if we should accept a full archive on our side
- The preferred transfer mechanism (secure FTP, Azure Blob SAS, or a signed drive link)

Please let us know asap — legal is asking for an acknowledgement to include in their incident report.

Thanks,
Dominic
Dominic Webb
Sr. Security Engineer, Acme Health
(d.webb@acmehealth.com)

--
Attachment: preliminary-observed-sessions.csv (summary)
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
To: Dominic Webb <d.webb@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 14 Aug 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request to preserve logs and transfer scope for EU incident

Hi Dominic — acknowledged. We've placed an immediate hold on the relevant retention buckets while we scope the export. Quick answers up front:

- Scope: we can do an EU-only preserve (BY region tag) and a separate global slice if requested.
- Start of retention: preservation begins now (2027-08-14T10:00:00Z) and will be held for 90 days by default; we can extend on request.
- Export options: we can produce both a redacted export and a full archive. Redacted export will remove PII fields you specify; full archive is available under an encrypted transfer.
- Transfer: we prefer a short-lived signed Drive folder or AzBlob SAS for EU transfers; SFTP is also possible but slower for large archives.

Can you confirm the exact list of account IDs and the time window (UTC) you need exported? Also copy in your legal contact if they want the preservation statement in writing.

I will loop in Karthik for the log slicing and transfer ops.

Best,
Jasmine
Jasmine Liu
Incident Response Lead, Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Dominic Webb <d.webb@acmehealth.com>
Date: Sat, 14 Aug 2027 12:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request to preserve logs and transfer scope for EU incident

Thanks. Operational details below — note this is intended to be prescriptive so your forensics team can plan ingestion.

1) Hold and slice
- We have created a hold tag: hold_acme_eu_20270814. It pins the raw session logs, auth traces, and KV cache snapshots across the EU region for 120 days to allow extended forensics if needed. Default hold is 90 days; Acme requested 120 to match their legal review window.
- Time window captured: 2027-08-13T22:00:00Z through 2027-08-14T06:00:00Z (per your initial report). If you need earlier/later slices, tell us the offsets.

2) Export formats and redaction
- Full archive: gzipped TAR (session-traces-aug14.tar.gz) containing raw logs, access logs, and kv-dump-aug14.json (we will encrypt at rest).
- Redacted export: we can remove user-identifying fields (email, phone, ssn-like tokens) and replace with hashed IDs. Redaction rules attached as forensic-checklist.xlsx.

3) Transfer options
- Preferred: Azure Blob SAS link scoped to EU region (short TTL) — we will provide upload URL and credentials.
- Alternative: Signed Google Drive folder with enforced 2FA.
- We can also provide an encrypted physical escrow if required by your policy (longer lead time).

4) Chain of custody and checksums
- We will produce SHA256 checksums for each archive and a signed manifest.
- Access logs for the exported artifacts will be retained for 365 days and shared on request.

Next steps: confirm account IDs and final retention length (we set 120 days as a placeholder). I will attach the manifest and a short SOP for ingestion.

-Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Principal, Site Reliability & Forensics, Redwood Inference

--
Attachment: forensic-checklist.xlsx (redaction rules and SOP)
From: Dominic Webb <d.webb@acmehealth.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
Cc: secops@acmehealth.com, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Aug 2027 15:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request to preserve logs and transfer scope for EU incident

Thanks Jasmine & Karthik — that plan works. Acme legal confirms 120 days hold is acceptable; please proceed with the EU-only preserve and the full encrypted archive. We prefer the Azure Blob SAS transfer. Please send the SAS link and the signed manifest when ready.

Also send the redaction spec to legal (legal.evidence@acmehealth.com) so they can approve the hashing approach before any redaction is applied.

We'll expect the artifacts and checksums by EOD Tue (2027-08-17 UTC). Appreciate the quick turnaround.

-Dominic

--
